title: AdvancedComsumables
description: Sign the contract. Enter the arena. Only one walks out.
body:
AdvancedConsumables is a premium PvP plugin that introduces a contract-based duel system combined with a powerful set of special consumable items.
Challenge any player by striking them with an Assassination Contract, teleport both combatants to a custom arena, and let strategy decide the outcome.

###

⚔️ CORE FEATURES

Everything you need for a complete PvP experience — ready out of the box.
No dependencies required
PlaceholderAPI support (optional)
Fully configurable via config.yml, consumables.yml, messages.yml

![dettales](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1e104ac7cd811af4920b2d473178a77bbb8be5a8.png) ###

⚔️ DUEL DETAILS

Duration: 120 seconds (configurable)
Contract cooldown: 300 seconds per player (configurable)
Commands are blocked during active duels
Arena boundaries are strictly enforced
Disconnect = automatic loss
Draw: both players lose inventory & return
Stats are saved automatically
World restrictions fully configurable

![consumibles](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/316bab7a67d5b46c742a89536318c631c29ece0d.png) ###

🧪 CONSUMABLE TYPES

###

🔴 EFFECT ELIXIRS — Temporary potion effects

Elixir of Strength — Strength I (10s)
Elixir of Shadows — Invisibility + Speed I (8s)
Elixir of Resistance — Resistance II (6s)

###

🔵 IMMUNITY ORBS — Block negative effects

Purification Orb — Blocks Poison, Wither & Weakness (10s)
Divine Shield — Blocks Slowness, Mining Fatigue & Blindness (15s)

###

🟠 UTILITY ITEMS — Change the fight dynamically

Swapper — Swap positions (30 blocks)
Shockwave — Push players (radius: 10)
Gravity Field — Pull zone (radius: 8)
Smoke Screen — Blindness + hidden nametags
Wind Feather — Dash forward (10 blocks)

Players can have a maximum of 2 active consumables.
All items are fully configurable.

![comandos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/afa8ff0cc997f741466ce798664eda791f0ff5ff.png) ###

📜 COMMANDS

/ac wand — Get the arena selection wand
/ac setarena — Save selected region as arena
/ac setspawn1 — Set spawn point 1
/ac setspawn2 — Set spawn point 2
/ac removearena — Remove arena
/ac reload — Reload configs
/ac givecontract — Get a contract
/ac giveconsumable <name> [amount] — Give item
/ac gui — Open GUI
/ac stats — View stats
/ac top — Leaderboard

Permission: advancedconsumables.admin
Aliases: /advancedconsumables, /ac

![placeholders](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/26d2535e341b8cb32f4da0f08ddcf3616be53e1d.png) ###

📊 PLACEHOLDERAPI

Optional integration for scoreboards & plugins:

%advancedconsumables_wins% — Total wins
%advancedconsumables_losses% — Total losses
%advancedconsumables_total% — Total duels
%advancedconsumables_top_wins_name% — Top player (wins)
%advancedconsumables_top_wins_count% — Highest wins
%advancedconsumables_top_losses_name% — Top player (losses)
%advancedconsumables_top_losses_count% — Highest losses

![requisitos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/849507a9b1618e55fb056b2e4796197f7ee4d34f_0.webp) ###

🔧 REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY

Paper / Spigot 1.21.4
Java 21+
PlaceholderAPI (optional)

⚠️ No dependencies required for core functionality
